-Wno-complain-wrong-lang.purpose: Suppresses an ESP-IDF warning option that is invalid for C sources in the P4 build.
-Wno-complain-wrong-lang.remove_when: The upstream headers/build no longer pass the C++-only warning option to C sources.

-Wno-deprecated-declarations.purpose: Suppresses deprecation warnings emitted by current ESPHome/ESP-IDF dependencies in P4 builds.
-Wno-deprecated-declarations.remove_when: Supported dependencies compile these device profiles without the deprecated declarations.

-Wno-literal-suffix.purpose: Suppresses the ESP-IDF header literal-suffix warning in P4 C++ builds.
-Wno-literal-suffix.remove_when: The upstream headers compile cleanly without the suppression.

-mtext-section-literals.purpose: Keeps Xtensa literal pools close enough for the large generated S3 firmware translation unit to link.
-mtext-section-literals.remove_when: The S3 firmware is split into smaller translation units or the toolchain makes the flag unnecessary.

ESPCONTROL_DISABLE_WEATHER_FORECAST=1.purpose: Excludes the weather-forecast card from the constrained S3 firmware.
ESPCONTROL_DISABLE_WEATHER_FORECAST=1.remove_when: The card compiles and runs with safe flash and heap headroom on that panel.

ESPCONTROL_DEVICE_SLUG=\"${device_slug}\.purpose: Injects the selected device profile slug into the compiled firmware for diagnostics and runtime identification.
ESPCONTROL_DEVICE_SLUG=\"${device_slug}\.remove_when: The device slug is supplied through generated component configuration instead of a preprocessor definition.

ESPCONTROL_ESPHOME_2026_5_REBUILD=1.purpose: Forces PlatformIO to rebuild objects after ESPHome 2026.5 scheduler and watchdog changes.
ESPCONTROL_ESPHOME_2026_5_REBUILD=1.remove_when: Stale 2026.4 objects are no longer present in supported caches, or a later marker supersedes it.

ESPCONTROL_JC1060P470_BOOTFIX_20260522=1.purpose: Cache-busting marker for the JC1060P470 boot-loop fix.
ESPCONTROL_JC1060P470_BOOTFIX_20260522=1.remove_when: A later required rebuild marker supersedes it.

ESPCONTROL_JC1060P470_OTA_WDT_20260526=1.purpose: Cache-busting marker for the JC1060P470 OTA flash erase watchdog increase.
ESPCONTROL_JC1060P470_OTA_WDT_20260526=1.remove_when: A later required rebuild marker supersedes it.

ESPCONTROL_JC4880P443_BOOTFIX_20260522=1.purpose: Cache-busting marker for the JC4880P443 boot-loop fix.
ESPCONTROL_JC4880P443_BOOTFIX_20260522=1.remove_when: A later required rebuild marker supersedes it.

ESPCONTROL_JC4880P443_OTA_WDT_20260522=1.purpose: Cache-busting marker for the JC4880P443 OTA flash erase watchdog increase.
ESPCONTROL_JC4880P443_OTA_WDT_20260522=1.remove_when: A later required rebuild marker supersedes it.

ESPCONTROL_JC8012P4A1_BOOTFIX_20260526=1.purpose: Cache-busting marker for the JC8012P4A1 boot-loop fix.
ESPCONTROL_JC8012P4A1_BOOTFIX_20260526=1.remove_when: A later required rebuild marker supersedes it.

ESPCONTROL_JC8012P4A1_GSL3680_TOUCH_SCAL.purpose: Cache-busting marker for restoring native display-space GSL3680 touch scaling.
ESPCONTROL_JC8012P4A1_GSL3680_TOUCH_SCAL.remove_when: A later required rebuild marker supersedes it.

ESPCONTROL_JC8012P4A1_GSL3680_WAKE_TAP_2.purpose: Cache-busting marker for the GSL3680 wake-tap handling change.
ESPCONTROL_JC8012P4A1_GSL3680_WAKE_TAP_2.remove_when: A later required rebuild marker supersedes it.

ESPCONTROL_JC8012P4A1_IMAGE_CARD_BOOTFIX.purpose: Cache-busting marker for an image-card boot fix.
ESPCONTROL_JC8012P4A1_IMAGE_CARD_BOOTFIX.remove_when: A later required rebuild marker supersedes it.

ESPCONTROL_JC8012P4A1_OTA_PREP_20260528=.purpose: Cache-busting marker for JC8012P4A1 OTA preparation changes.
ESPCONTROL_JC8012P4A1_OTA_PREP_20260528=.remove_when: A later required rebuild marker supersedes it.

ESPCONTROL_JC8012P4A1_RESTORE_CRASH_RECO.purpose: Cache-busting marker for restore crash recovery.
ESPCONTROL_JC8012P4A1_RESTORE_CRASH_RECO.remove_when: A later required rebuild marker supersedes it.

ESPCONTROL_JC8012P4A1_USB_LOGGER_UART0_2.purpose: Cache-busting marker for the JC8012P4A1 USB logger and UART0 change.
ESPCONTROL_JC8012P4A1_USB_LOGGER_UART0_2.remove_when: A later required rebuild marker supersedes it.

ESPCONTROL_JC8012P4A1_WDT_20260526=1.purpose: Cache-busting marker for the JC8012P4A1 watchdog increase.
ESPCONTROL_JC8012P4A1_WDT_20260526=1.remove_when: A later required rebuild marker supersedes it.

ESPCONTROL_KEEP_LVGL_ACTIVE_ON_DISPLAY_O.purpose: Keeps LVGL processing active while the panel is electrically off so scheduled and touch wake paths remain available.
ESPCONTROL_KEEP_LVGL_ACTIVE_ON_DISPLAY_O.remove_when: ESPHome/LVGL can suspend and resume these panels without losing wake behavior.

ESPCONTROL_LOW_HEAP_COVER_ART=1.purpose: Uses the reduced-memory cover-art path on the constrained S3 panel.
ESPCONTROL_LOW_HEAP_COVER_ART=1.remove_when: The full cover-art path fits with safe runtime heap headroom.

ESPCONTROL_LOW_HEAP_MEDIA_CONTROL=1.purpose: Uses the reduced-memory media modal path on the constrained S3 panel.
ESPCONTROL_LOW_HEAP_MEDIA_CONTROL=1.remove_when: The full media path fits with safe runtime heap headroom.

ESPCONTROL_MAX_GRID_SLOTS=6.purpose: Caps runtime grid allocation to six slots.
ESPCONTROL_MAX_GRID_SLOTS=6.remove_when: Grid slot capacity is generated from device profile data.

ESPCONTROL_MAX_GRID_SLOTS=9.purpose: Caps runtime grid allocation to nine slots.
ESPCONTROL_MAX_GRID_SLOTS=9.remove_when: Grid slot capacity is generated from device profile data.

LV_USE_BIDI=1.purpose: Enables LVGL bidirectional text ordering for right-to-left scripts such as Hebrew and Arabic.
LV_USE_BIDI=1.remove_when: ESPHome enables LVGL bidirectional text for every supported display without this compile definition.
